examples.text: Nice tune. What's on the flipside?

glosses: A necessary consequence or corollary of something that acts as a negation or counterbalance; especially one seen as opposite, or as pro versus con.

examples.text: Walking to work is definitely healthier – on the flipside, though, it takes twice as long.
Of course, the drop is partly the flipside of dollars being in demand. The pound does not benefit from safe-haven status like the Swiss franc or Japanese yen.

glosses: The occasion when we meet again (e.g. when I return from work, etc.; said on parting); later or tomorrow.

examples.text: See you on the flipside!
